rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a small, simple dwelling or shelter.

example.english: They turned this hut into a coffee shop.
example.traditional: 呢間小屋畀人改做咖啡店喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 uk1 bei2 jan4 goi2 zou6 gaa3 fe1 dim3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the hut is thatched or made mainly from straw or similar natural materials.

example.english: The thatched hut at the village entrance is still there.
example.jyutping: cyun1 hau2 go2 gaan1 maau4 uk1 zung6 hai2 dou6
